attention.dense_execution.inputs: Query, key and value tensors, logical token positions, visibility mask, KV cache views, head geometry and rotary settings.
attention.dense_execution.outputs: Attention output rows in query order, with normalization statistics where partitioned results must be merged.

attention.sparse_execution.inputs: Queries, indexed or compressed keys and values, logical positions, scoring parameters and the allowed selection budget.
attention.sparse_execution.outputs: Updated index state, selected block or row IDs and attention output rows for the selected positions.

batch.execution_layout.inputs: Scheduled tokens with positions, sequence state handles, adapter identities and backend batch limits.
batch.execution_layout.outputs: Microbatch partitions, row offsets and mappings from each execution lane to its request, token position and state.

decode.advance_sequence.inputs: Prompt or committed token IDs, current positions, prefix or session state, batch mappings and the model runner.
decode.advance_sequence.outputs: Updated sequence positions and state, plus next-token logits at the requested prompt or decode boundary.

decode.speculative_execution.inputs: Accepted token history, draft and target model state, proposed tokens and target scores, sampling policy and draft effort budget.
decode.speculative_execution.outputs: Verified token prefix and continuation decision, synchronized target and draft state after acceptance or rollback, and the next proposal budget.

dense.feed_forward.inputs: Hidden rows, projection weights, configured activation, weight formats and scales for the selected device.
dense.feed_forward.outputs: Transformed hidden rows in token order for the decoder’s next residual or layer operation.

merge.expert_contributions.inputs: Token rows with selected expert IDs and mixture weights, valid assignment counts and the expert-local output rows for recombination.
merge.expert_contributions.outputs: Grouped rows and expert offsets for execution, an inverse map back to token and choice, and weighted sums restored to token order.

model.decoder_architecture.inputs: Checkpoint layer configuration and bound tensor handles, token hidden rows, positions and sequence state for the configured sublayers.
model.decoder_architecture.outputs: Hidden rows after the configured attention, feed-forward, normalization and residual operations, with the resulting sequence state.

model.embedding_service.inputs: Token IDs, vocabulary table and, for configured variants, token history, layer identity and n-gram embedding tables.
model.embedding_service.outputs: Embedding rows aligned with the supplied token order, or an error for IDs outside the configured vocabulary.

model.expert_routing.inputs: Per-token router scores or a token-keyed routing table, per-layer expert counts, routed width, ranking bias, group policy and mixture scaling.
model.expert_routing.outputs: Selected expert IDs paired with their contribution weights for each token, ready for grouping and expert weight lookup.

model.logit_head.inputs: Final hidden rows, output weights or tied embedding weights, and configured normalization, scaling and softcapping rules.
model.logit_head.outputs: One logit per vocabulary entry for each requested row, in the model’s vocabulary order and output precision.

observability.runtime_events.inputs: Request, layer and expert events, dispatch and readiness events, correlation IDs, clocks and trace-buffer capacity.
observability.runtime_events.outputs: Correlated phase timestamps, counters and ordered trace records, with an overflow indication when records are lost.

sampling.select_tokens.inputs: Vocabulary logits, request sampling parameters, random generator state, active grammar constraints and stop conditions.
sampling.select_tokens.outputs: Selected token IDs, updated random and constraint state, and the decision to continue or finish each sequence.

scheduler.request_lifecycle.inputs: Queued or cancelled requests, prefix matches, available slots and KV capacity, token budgets and completed worker steps.
scheduler.request_lifecycle.outputs: Admitted sequences and scheduled prompt or decode work, request-state transitions, and released slots and memory reservations.

sequence.recurrent_execution.inputs: Token activations, previous recurrent state, learned parameters, sequence identities and chunk boundaries.
sequence.recurrent_execution.outputs: Recurrent output rows and updated state for the next step, with state copies or resets when a sequence branches or retires.

serving.request_gateway.inputs: Client completion requests and stream disconnects, launcher configuration and mounted files, readiness probes and enabled diagnostic requests.
serving.request_gateway.outputs: Requests or cancellation signals to the scheduler, completion responses or streamed text to clients, and readiness or diagnostic responses to operators.

tokenizer.prepare_request.inputs: Messages or prompt text, template, vocabulary and special-token policy for encoding, and committed output IDs with decoder state for streaming.
tokenizer.prepare_request.outputs: Prompt token IDs and offsets for scheduling, and decoded UTF-8 text chunks for the response writer.

model.expert_ffn.inputs: Expert-grouped hidden rows and offsets, ready gate, up and down projection weights, plus the activation, dtype and expert-output normalization parameters declared by the layer.
model.expert_ffn.outputs: Unweighted expert-local output rows in the same packed order, after any configured expert-output normalization.
